prompt: Implement matrix multiplication: multiply an r x n matrix a by an n x c matrix b, returning the r x c product where each cell is a dot product of a row of a and a column of b.
explanation: The product of an r x n and an n x c matrix is r x c: cell (i, j) is the dot product of row i of a with column j of b, computed by the innermost loop over the shared dimension k. The three loops each have one job -- i picks the result row, j picks the result column, k accumulates a[i][k] * b[k][j]. Multiplying by the identity matrix returning the original, and a*b differing from b*a, are the classic sanity checks of a correct implementation.
hints: The result has a.length rows and b[0].length columns; allocate new int[a.length][b[0].length].
Use three nested loops: i over result rows, j over result columns, k over the shared inner dimension (b.length).
Accumulate sum += a[i][k] * b[k][j] in the innermost loop, then store it in result[i][j].
